tasks.question: What did Dermata Therapeutics report for its second quarter of 2026 (revenue, net income, diluted EPS, and year-over-year revenue growth), and how did the results compare with any outlook for that quarter published with its first-quarter 2026 results?
tasks.sources: Q2 2026 release (EX-99.1, accession 0001493152-26-037124, fixtures/drma/cur.htm): "reported financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026"; Statements of Operations, "Quarter Ended June 30, ... In thousands, except share and per share data": "Net loss | $ | (2,967 |" (2026 column; no noncontrolling interest line, so this is the amount attributable to the company), "Net loss per common share, basic and diluted | $ | (0.74 |". The release reports no revenue line (statement of operations starts at operating expenses), so the revenue fact and the year-over-year revenue comparison are omitted. Q1 2026 release (EX-99.1, accession 0001493152-26-022710, fixtures/drma/pri.htm): no numeric outlook for the second quarter (only a statement that cash resources are expected to fund operations into the first quarter of 2027) -> guidance_absent.

tasks.sources: Q2 2026 release (EX-99.01, accession 0001364954-26-000085, fixtures/chgg/cur.htm): "today reported financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026"; CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS "(in thousands, except per share amounts)", Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 | 2025: "Net revenues | $ | 51,849 | $ | 105,120", "Net loss | $ | (2,951) | $ | (35,663)" (no noncontrolling interest line), "Net loss per share, basic and diluted | $ | (0.03) | $ | (0.33)"; highlight "Total Net Revenues of $51.8 million, a decrease of 51% year-over-year". Q1 2026 release (EX-99.01, accession 0001364954-26-000045, fixtures/chgg/pri.htm), Business Outlook, Second Quarter 2026: "Total Net Revenues in the range of $49 million to $50 million" (also a Chegg Skilling revenue range, gross margin and adjusted EBITDA ranges, which are not total revenue/EPS and are ignored); no EPS outlook was given.

tasks.question: What did Teradata report for its second quarter of 2026 (revenue, net income, diluted EPS, and year-over-year revenue growth), and how did the results compare with any outlook for that quarter published with its first-quarter 2026 results?
tasks.sources: Q2 2026 release (EX-99.1, accession 0001628280-26-052549, fixtures/tdc/cur.htm): "today announced its second quarter 2026 financial results"; statement of operations "(in millions, except per share amounts - unaudited)", Three Months 2026 | 2025: "Total revenue | 410 | 408", "Net income | $ | 46 | $ | 9" (no noncontrolling interest line), Net income per common share "Diluted | $ | 0.48 | $ | 0.09"; text: "Total revenue was $410 million versus $408 million", "GAAP diluted EPS was $0.48 versus $0.09 per share". Q1 2026 release (EX-99.1, accession 0001628280-26-030514, fixtures/tdc/pri.htm), Outlook "For the second quarter of 2026": "GAAP diluted EPS is expected to be in the range of $0.22 to $0.26 per share" (GAAP entry used). The same outlook also gives "Non-GAAP diluted EPS is expected to be in the range of $0.53 to $0.57 per share" (cur actual non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.69, also above that range) and "Total revenue in the range of -4% to -2% year-over-year"; the revenue outlook is a percentage growth range, not an amount, so no revenue guidance entry is included.
